CREDITS for saturn/ (Saturn vector benchmarks, copied into penguin-workloads)
=============================================================================

Origin of the copied benchmark sources (copied; two files carry a marked local fix, see NOTICE):
  repo   : ucb-ee194-tapeout/saturn-vectors  (git@github.com:ucb-ee194-tapeout/saturn-vectors.git)
  commit : de04946ac1ce878c79a4d6e74e493c5f440908e2  (Thu Apr 23 2026, "fix benchmark compilation issues")
  path   : benchmarks/   (read via tapeout-chipyard @ 48c3a7d11f6de3f0cecb33ae6a31c24ec26ff9d8,
           submodule generators/saturn)
  licence: BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2024 The Regents of the University of California
           (see LICENSE). Third-party code inside it keeps its own licence: see NOTICE.

Origin of benchmarks/env/{encoding.h,LICENSE}:
  repo   : riscv/riscv-test-env  (https://github.com/riscv/riscv-test-env.git), a submodule of
           saturn-vectors at benchmarks/env, commit 1c577dc7c7d6aee27b8d5cb0e2e87c8473e3ad12
  encoding.h itself says: BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2023 RISC-V International, generated from
           riscv/riscv-opcodes (02b4866).

What was left out of the copy: the 14 OPU/custom-matrix benchmarks (opu-*, vec-bdot, vec-optest;
the Penguin chip has no OPU), the upstream Makefile and run script, common/{crt.S,syscalls.c,test.ld}
(Saturn's own startup/HTIF, replaced by Zephyr), env/{p,pm,pt,v} (test environments), and the
prebuilt x86 binary vec-fp8/gen_data.

Files of ours (not from Saturn), all in shim/, conf/, CMakeLists.txt, prj.conf, testcase.yaml:
  shim/stats_shim.c   re-implements setStats() from saturn-vectors benchmarks/common/syscalls.c
                      @ de04946 (original authors of that file: dpgrubb13)
  shim/exit_shim.c    same code as cmake/plain_app/exit_shim.c of our board repo (zephyr-chipyard-bsp @93ace03, now zephyr-penguin)
  shim/include/driver/rocket-chip/l_trace_encoder/l_trace_encoder.h
                      no-op stub of a driver header that Saturn's sources include but that lives
                      outside saturn-vectors (baremetal-ide); only the declarations the benchmarks use.
  build structure     modelled on external/atlas_upstream of zephyr-chipyard-bsp (ATLAS_TEST pattern).

Per-file authors
----------------
Names are the git author names from `git -C generators/saturn log --follow --format='%an' -- <file>`
at the commit above, most commits first. Paths are relative to saturn/ here and to
saturn-vectors/ upstream (identical).
Generated files (data.S) are produced by the gen_data.* scripts next to them; their authors are those
of the generator history as listed.
